sharingCriteriaRules.description: Every shipment (every record has a tracking number) is shared Read/Write with the RutaCargo support agents (BR-03). Delete stays with the owner and administrators.
sharingCriteriaRules.label: All shipments to support agents

sharingCriteriaRules.description: Every shipment (every record has a tracking number) is shared Read/Write with the EntregaYa integration group so status updates can be applied (BR-04). Field access is limited by the RutaCargo_EntregaYa_Integration permission set to the five status fields; delete stays with the owner and administrators.
sharingCriteriaRules.label: All shipments to EntregaYa integration
